description: This script measures the startup memory usage (RSS) of the 'openclaw.mjs' application on different commands such as help, status, and gateway status. It sets up environment variables, creates temporary files for resource usage hooks, runs the commands with specific memory limits, parses the output for maximum RSS, and reports if usage exceeds predefined thresholds. The script is primarily used in CI pipelines to monitor startup memory characteristics.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance messages for fixing startup memory issues based on test case and details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Creates a formatted error message including guidance for fixing detected issues.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses the maximum RSS value from stderr output based on a predefined marker.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Builds and returns a custom environment object for running benchmark cases, setting temporary directories and relevant environment variables.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Executes a test case by spawning a child process with specific environment, analyzes the output for RSS usage, and throws errors if limits are exceeded or issues are detected.
